Why: through β2 and Gs noradrenaline sensitises nociceptors
Note: Sympathetic noradrenaline raises TMJ OA pain and acts on sensory neurons through β receptors (not β2 resolved); adrenaline causes β-mediated hyperalgesia. On immune cells β2 is anti-inflammatory (Elenkov 2000), the reason the colour rests on pain.
